summary: Sensitive forms keep autofill/secure attributes: iOS contentType username/password/newPassword/emailAddress/oneTimeCode passed through FSField/FSCodeField; web autocomplete current-password/new-password/username/email/one-time-code set on SignIn/Reset/Forgot/MFA; payout, donation and subscription inputs untouched (autocomplete counts equal to base). Added re-mask on blur, app background and after 10s (spec 9.1.1) on both platforms. No sensitive values logged. Open: SX2 re-auth sheet, SX3 typed-confirm sheet and privacy shield (spec 9.1.6) are not built; delete-account keeps its existing inline typed confirm.
